notes.title: MONITOR Patch V1.32 and ALIX Patch 1.1 - Also...
notes.content:
Hey all!

Just a few bits here and there:

MONITOR:

- DLC menu reflects the fact that if you want to run ALIX, go to the Steam Client and select it. [b]It will not run from MONITOR. You have to go in the Steam Client.[/b]
- Disk 6 has been fixed. An odd occurrence made it vanish and glitch - so that's fixed!

ALIX:

- Loading screen was borked in a secret ending. Now fixed.
- Intro movie was replaced with better version.
- [b]Additional[/b] - An achievement wasn't being activated in one particular ending. If you go in to the endings menu for [spoiler]"Cut the Air Supply"[/spoiler] - this will unlock for you. For anyone else, this will unlock correctly now.

AND ALSO!!!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30530657/babbff4fe7c1e928ee920c1cd59e3e6ab4de6b17.png[/img]

ALIX: A MONITOR Story's Soundtrack is going to be released next week! 

Thanks for playing. Appreciate ya.

Dave. (DNT Games)

notes.title: V1.26 Patch
notes.content:
Just a few bits and pieces!

[b]Subtitles[/b]
I've added something which may stabilise the subtitles a little bit. It probably won't but this is the best I can do for now.

Sadly, it does mean having to go over the whole game again and redoing it. Obviously this can't be done within a day (as the game itself took a year!) and Unreal Engine is very intensive with what it wants to make it work. 

I doubt I will go over 3 hours of dialogue to do this so sadly, if it doesn't work; you will have to turn them off as I can't do anything more for lower end PC's due to Unreal Engine 4. Sorry.

[b]Other Menu Bugs[/b]
A few overlay bugs have been fixed.

[b]Other News[/b]
I may consider creating a walkthrough at some point but there's still hints here: 

http://steamcommunity.com/app/672650/discussions/0/1496741765124478997/

Also, there's going to be DLC coming for the game in December called "ALIX: A MONITOR Story". You can view the trailer for it now!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-4mmlpXYLvc

Thanks again for all of you playing. I really appreciate it.

notes.title: V1.25 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello all!

Wow, did I have a lot of bugs to fix. Special thanks to Taco Chip for finding a lot of them but the new patch is coming in the next hour or so. Make sure to update so you can take advantage.

[B]Bug Fixes[/b]

- A way to stop clicking the Events board once you're looking at the Dolos statue on Day Two.
- Day Three Billiard Room Subs fixed.
- Sundry Disk now spawns properly on Day One. A new disk has also been added to the Harrowing ending. So all six are accessible. Remember you need all eight documents before Sundry appears.
- Load screens fixed in certain circumstances.
- Options remember your choices once you've clicked them for the first time. When you reload, however, these will reset but it is easy to put them back the way you want them. This will be fixed in future releases but isn't important right now.


[B]Functionality Added[/b]

- A way to change from Window to Fullscreen mode in the options.
- A new hidden part that was going to be a secret...but I think Taco Chip may have rumbled me too soon...so it's in now!

[b]Functionality Removed[/b]

- The Pause Menu in game has been removed as this was added way late in to the final builds. Sadly, it never really worked and it just destroys the true vibe of real-time that the game needs. So you can't pause the game now; once you're in - you're in! Sorry!

[b]Other Notes from Comments made[/b]

You can glitch the game out by clicking too quick between screens and it technically was not meant to be played too fast. However, I am aware of that now but I've got to think of a way to stop it in future. It's on the horizon though but I need to think it through...so don't be too fast!

The actual option to change what effects on screen is something I can look in to but isn't too important right now. This will be some way off.

There is no red x's under the chair. That's just the chair legs.

The game won't have the names of people talking. This was something I toyed with but it butchered the idea that you are meant to figure out who is whom so it won't be added.

I know there will be other bugs but the game for now, these should make things a little better.

Thanks for playing!

ADDITIONAL CHANGE:
All endings achievement is now accessible in endings menu and final Sundry achievement is unlocked once all docs are attained in menu. There's two hidden ones (one of which is super hidden!)

notes.title: Patch v1.2
notes.content:
Hey all!

New patch has been released from a lot of people telling me what is wrong. Please keep letting me know what you find so I can get the game the best it can be.

NOTES

- Fixed Fullscreen issues; should now hopefully scale to whatever native resolution you have. If not, let me know.
- "You Did Nothing" Ending Achievement - if you've played through and got this ending; you may have noticed you didn't get the achievement. If you go in to the Endings Menu and click the "You Did Nothing" selection; it will now unlock.
- Loading fixes. Been some issues with one of the endings not loading. This should hopefully now be fixed.

[EDIT] Additional Change:

- Some movies and sound files were not working so now you should get some tidbits for intros to certain days. Be sure to update and you'll get these new changes.

Thanks again!
